name: Mechanic
description: Repair vehicles, keep engines humming, and rescue breakdowns.

successMessages: Your diagnostic test wowed the garage foreman. Grab a wrench!
failureMessages: They want more certifications on file. Ace another course and return.

successMessages: You rebuilt an engine in record time and satisfied a fleet client.
Every car left the shop purring like new.
Your quick roadside rescue saved someone's vacation.
bonusMessages: The garage owner paid extra for a tough repair.
A grateful driver tipped you for the life-saving fix.
failureMessages: A stripped bolt meant replacing extra parts from your pocket.
A comeback repair forced you to refund some labour.
